📢 TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Grand Falls-Windsor RCMP advises of slowed travel along the Trans-Canada Highway, due to a tractor trailer jackknifed west of the Norris Arm turnoff. Emergency crews are on the scene directing traffic.

Although the Trans-Canada Highway remains passable at this time, motorists are urged to reduce their speed and approach the area with added caution. 

Updates will be provided when information is available.

#nltraffic
